newsitem.title: USA: Securacom Inc changes proposed IPO price.
newsitem.headline: Securacom Inc changes proposed IPO price.

text.p: Securacom Inc on Monday changed the estimated price to buy into its initial public offering in a regulatory filing.
The company filed in May for an offering of two million shares to price at $10 each but in a new filing, it amended the price to a range between $8.50 and $10.50 each.
The IPO is scheduled for the last week of June or early July, according to lead underwriter Hanifen Imhoff Inc. It will have an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 shares.

According to its prospectus, the consulting and engineering company will sell 1.4 million shares in the offering and current shareholders will sell 600,000. Proceeds will be used to repay outstanding debt, upgrade operations and for other working capital needs.
In 1996, the company reported a net loss of $2.5 million on revenue of $5.82 million. That compares with a net loss of $1.76 million, on revenue of $3.17 million the year earlier.
After the offering, the company will have 5,834,140 shares outstanding. The shares are proposed to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol "SECU."
